title: The Boat and the Rain
summary: A boy and his boat face stormy weather but discover they can stay safe together.

pages.text: A boy named Jay had a small boat he loved very much.
pages.scene: Young boy standing proudly next to a sailboat at the shore

pages.text: One day Jay took his boat out into the bay.
pages.scene: Boy sailing peacefully on calm, blue water

pages.text: The sky began to look gray and mean.
pages.scene: Dark clouds gathering quickly on the horizon

pages.text: Rain began to fall and Jay felt afraid.
pages.scene: Heavy rain pouring down, boat rocking in waves

pages.text: The boat seemed so small under the big, dark sky.
pages.scene: Tiny boat surrounded by enormous storm clouds

pages.text: But Jay could steer and he stayed very brave.
pages.scene: Boy gripping the boat's wheel firmly, determined

pages.text: The boat began to float and sail toward the shore.
pages.scene: Boat moving steadily through rough waves toward land

pages.text: Jay sang a slow, sweet song as he sailed on.
pages.scene: Boy singing peacefully despite the storm around him

pages.text: The rain began to slow and then to stop.
The sun came out and made a bright rainbow.
pages.scene: Rainbow arcing across the sky after the storm

pages.text: Jay's boat made it to the beach safe and dry.
pages.scene: Boat safely beached with boy standing proudly

pages.text: Jay learned he could be brave when things got hard.
pages.scene: Boy hugging his boat, sunset glowing behind them
Jay and boat silhouetted against calm evening water
